# Bricks of India
> Every Brick Tells a Story — India's only LEGO® price comparison, review, and news platform. Live prices across Indian retailers, honest set reviews with India price context, and LEGO news written for Indian fans.

## What this site does
- Tracks daily LEGO prices across 2 Indian stores: Toycra, MyBrickHouse
- Publishes independent set reviews with an India-specific verdict (BUY NOW / WAIT / IMPORT ONLY / AVOID) and local INR prices
- Publishes LEGO news with India context — arrival dates, import prices, retailer availability
- Runs The Lab: experimental LEGO data tools built for India (see below)
- Maintains a guide library for Indian LEGO fans
- Features opinion writing on the Indian LEGO hobby, pricing, and culture

## Key sections

### Price comparison
- [All sets](https://www.bricksofindia.com/sets): Search across 24,000+ LEGO sets globally; live Indian retailer pricing on 600+ sets currently stocked in India
- [Deals](https://www.bricksofindia.com/deals): Current LEGO deals and discounts across Indian stores
- [Themes](https://www.bricksofindia.com/themes): Browse LEGO sets by theme with Indian prices

### Editorial
- [Reviews](https://www.bricksofindia.com/reviews): Independent LEGO set reviews — India price, local availability, honest verdict
- [News](https://www.bricksofindia.com/news): LEGO news written from an India perspective (100+ original news articles)
- [Guides](https://www.bricksofindia.com/guides): LEGO 101 for Indian fans — buying, storing, themes, customs duties (9 guides)
- [Opinion](https://www.bricksofindia.com/news?category=Opinion): Commentary on LEGO pricing, certified stores, and Indian hobby culture
- [Community](https://www.bricksofindia.com/community): Indian AFOL builder spotlights and community stories

### The Lab — experimental tools
- [Biryani Index](https://www.bricksofindia.com/lab/biryani-index): LEGO price converted to biryani plates, chai cups, and petrol litres — India's irreverent price reality check
- [India Deals Today](https://www.bricksofindia.com/lab/deals): Today's lowest prices across Indian stores
- [Which Set Are You?](https://www.bricksofindia.com/lab/which-set): 5-question quiz matching you to a LEGO set
- [CMF Tracker](https://www.bricksofindia.com/lab/cmf-tracker): Track your LEGO Collectible Minifigure collection across Series 20–29
- [Budget Calculator](https://www.bricksofindia.com/lab/budget-calculator): Find LEGO sets within your INR budget, sorted by piece count
- [Retiring Soon](https://www.bricksofindia.com/lab/retiring-soon): Live retiring-soon set tracker with best Indian store price
- [LEGO Heat Map](https://www.bricksofindia.com/lab/heat-map): LEGO search interest by Indian state — D3 choropleth, 23 states, city drill-down

### About
- [About](https://www.bricksofindia.com/about): About Abhinav Bhargav and the Bricks of India project

## About the author
All content is written by Abhinav Bhargav, founder of Bricks of India. 20+ years in enterprise sales, marketing, and account management. Cornell University. Running Bricks of India on YouTube, Instagram, and web since 2024. Listed in the Brickset App Directory (May 2026).

## Data sourcing
- Prices scraped daily from Toycra and MyBrickHouse official Shopify APIs
- Set catalogue: 24,000+ sets synced weekly from Rebrickable
- Retirement dates: Brickset API (exitDate field), updated weekly
- All prices in INR. Scraper runs every 6 hours via GitHub Actions.

## Content policy
Reviews are independent and not sponsored. News posts are original — not summaries of other sites. Prices are live data, not manually entered. No affiliate relationships with LEGO Group.
